slots.name: team ranking
slots.sentence: Two prominent Texas high school football teams, No. 16 Duncanville and Allen, face off in their season opener.

slots.name: final score
slots.sentence: The Eagles upset the Panthers in a rematch of last year’s Class 6A Division I state semifinal, winning 26-7 to start the regular season 1-0.

slots.name: season record
slots.sentence: Duncanville enters the season after a 12-2 campaign, while Allen finished last season 14-1.

slots.name: receptions
slots.sentence: Duncanville went 12-2 last season, making a run to the UIL Class 6A Division I championship game before losing to North Shore 10-7.

slots.name: Allen season record
slots.sentence: Allen went 14-1 last season and looked ready to make a run to a state championship game before running into Duncanville in the state semifinals.

slots.name: season start record
slots.sentence: The Eagles upset the Panthers in a rematch of last year’s Class 6A Division I state semifinal, winning 26-7 to start the regular season 1-0.

slots.name: kickoff time
slots.sentence: Kickoff is set for 7 p.m. CT.

slots.name: Allen scoring drives
slots.sentence: Ty Snell's debut with Allen was solid, as he commanded the Eagle offense for four scoring drives, despite throwing a pair of interceptions.

slots.name: touchdown distance
slots.sentence: 5:57 4Q: Allen was poised to score off the great field position, as CJ Snell found Zach Williams, who took one cut and found his way to the end zone from 20 yards out. Allen now leads 19-7 with under six minutes to play here.

slots.name: total interceptions
slots.sentence: 10:13 4Q: With Duncanville starting to threaten, Allen takes the momentum right back. Denson gets picked by Trey Roberson, who snags it at the Allen 6-yard line.

slots.name: half-time clock
slots.sentence: HALF: The Panthers got a key stop downfield on a Ty Snell pass, which was picked by Riley Lewis with 23 seconds to go in the first half.

slots.name: touchdown drive distance
slots.sentence: 0:50 2Q: Duncanville's Maximus The Great Denson lofted one to a wide-open Trenton Yancey, who caps off a one play, 53-yard touchdown drive to get within one score. Allen still leads, 12-7.

slots.name: Allen game score
slots.sentence: 6:17 2Q: The Eagles drive the length of the field and get their second touchdown of the game thanks to a short touchdown run from Lyndon Spriggs. After a failed two-point conversion, it's 12-0.

slots.name: game score progression
slots.sentence: 1:44 1Q: Ty Snell scrambles, decides not to run, but finds Cylas Siciliano on a crossing pattern open in the end zone. Eagles on the board first but miss the extra-point, 6-0.

slots.name: Duncanville national ranking
slots.sentence: The Panthers enter the year ranked as the No. 16 team in the latest USA TODAY Sports Super 25 rankings and No. 2 in the USA TODAY Sports Super 15 Southwest region football rankings.

slots.name: Duncanville scoring drives
slots.sentence: Allen's defense, outside of one touchdown drive in the second quarter, played a solid game and often disrupted Duncanville's offensive line up front.
